# Andrew Virya Victorio

> Offensive Security Practitioner.

## Overview
Andrew Virya Victorio is a web application security and penetration testing practitioner based in Indonesia, with hands-on background in data and infrastructure engineering. This site showcases red-team/offensive security perspective and access to the portfolio deck and scheduling.

## Core Focus
- Web Application Security & Penetration Testing
- Vulnerability Research & Exploitation Analysis
- Offensive & Developer Tooling (Rust, Python, TypeScript/Next.js)
- Infrastructure & Telemetry Context (SIEM, Zero-Trust mesh, data platforms)
